data: For the fiscal year ended June 30, 2025, Microsoft reported total revenue of about $281.7 billion and net income of about $101.8 billion. Revenue rose roughly 15% from $245.1 billion in fiscal year 2024. Net income grew about 16% from $88.1 billion in fiscal 2024, and diluted earnings per share were about $13.64. Microsoft Cloud and especially Azure drove much of the revenue growth. These figures come from my training knowledge of Microsoft's fiscal 2025 annual results, so check them against the company's Form 10-K if you need exact numbers to the million.
